title: Speciesism in AI: Evaluating Discrimination Against Animals in Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion. It mentions 'religious beliefs' once as a cultural factor for future research into speciesist patterns but does not measure or report any findings on the topic within the current study.
